display_labels.Q: Questionable / current availability or workload uncertainty
display_labels.D: Doubtful / currently unlikely to play or carry normal workload
display_labels.O: Out / verified expected absence for the relevant game or opening period
display_labels.IR: Injured Reserve / verified reserve-injured roster status

rules: The label represents the latest resolved current state, not the most severe historical injury state.
IR may only be assigned after a verified reserve/injured transaction; injury severity alone cannot create an IR label.

O may be assigned from verified expected unavailability even before an official game-status report exists; this is a Chuck The Duke current-availability label, not a claim that the club has issued an official NFL game designation.
D is used when credible current evidence makes participation or a normal workload unlikely but absence is not yet resolved as out.
Q is used when an active injury/recovery issue creates meaningful participation or workload uncertainty.
A player who has fully cleared the relevant injury receives no injury label; stale Q/D/O tags are prohibited.
PUP/NFI are retained as roster-state details in the chronology. They do not display as IR unless the player is actually placed on reserve/injured.
Every displayed label must link to a current injury-review record and captured_at date.
